extracted.name: Meaty Thick Man Chili
extracted.description: Contrary to the title, it doesn’t have men in it. However it is a man’s best friend, it’s thick, not as tomato-ey as most chili’s. Best served with fresh bread.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped
1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped
instruction_lines: Cook ground beef in a large pot over medium-high heat, stirring to crumble, until evenly browned. Drain off grease.

Reduce heat to medium; add kidney beans, bell peppers, onion, and garlic to pot. Cook and stir, 1 to 3 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce and water; season with chili powder. Simmer over low heat, uncovered, for 40 minutes.
